event_chain.summary: Microsoft 365 account compromised - method not disclosed
Fraudulent 'payment report' email sent as town administrator

summary: On Friday morning, October 23, 2026, the Town of Whitsett, North Carolina's town hall Microsoft 365 account was hacked and used to send a fake email bearing a town administrator's signature with the subject 'Ref: Approved Payment Report from Whitsett, NC', attachments and links. IT provider Brooks Networking secured the affected accounts, and the town warned residents and recipients not to open the attachments or click the links.
